# atoms_from_mofdb_df { #mofography.data.atoms_from_mofdb_df }

```python
data.atoms_from_mofdb_df(mofdb_df)
```

This function takes a MOFDB dataframe from get_data_from_mofdb routine, which has a column called 'cif' that contains CIF data as strings, and
returns a list of ASE atoms objects

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                             | Default    |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------|------------|
| mofdb_df |        | the dataframe containing the MOFDB data | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description              |
|--------|--------|--------------------------|
|        |        | A list of atoms objects. |
